release_notes:
Stability and reliability pass.

Reliability:
  - Parser no longer deadlocks on impossible payload lengths
  - CRC bursts no longer flood the UI event loop
  - Analysis Suite no longer crashes when closing during a log load
  - Loggers retain file-handle ownership so slow-disk shutdowns do not lose data
  - Main window waits for log writers to flush before closing or updating

Installer:
  - Silent downgrades are now blocked
  - Program Files upgrades no longer race their own uninstaller
  - App icon now shows in Programs & Features
  - Privilege-split guard prevents parallel installs when a machine-wide install exists

Other:
  - Auto-updater uses packaging.version for safer version comparison
  - Decoder hot-path ~1.9x faster for fixed-width ints (cached struct.unpack_from)
